extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) My environment — family (mother, father, brother, sister, grandparents), home (rooms, furniture), school (teachers, classmates, classrooms). Environment is everything around us — people, plants, animals, buildings, land, water. (2) Local animals and birds — sparrow, crow, pigeon, parrot (birds seen on trees and rooftops), dog, cat, cow, goat (animals seen on streets and homes), fish, duck (in water), earthworm, snake (underground). Simple classification by where they live. (3) Local plants and trees — mango tree (fruits in summer), neem tree (medicine, bitter leaves), coconut tree (coconut, water), tulsi plant (medicine, worship), banyan tree (shade, aerial roots), peepal tree (heart-shaped leaves). Seasonal observation — trees lose leaves in winter, new leaves in spring, flowers in spring/summer. (4) Physical features of locality — land features (mountains, hills, plains, plateaus, deserts), water features (rivers, ponds, lakes, seas, wells). Children observe what is around their home and school. (5) Food — where it comes from: from plants (rice, wheat, fruits, vegetables, pulses, spices), from animals (milk from cow/buffalo, eggs from hen, honey from bees, meat from animals), from both (bread needs wheat from plants + yeast, paneer needs milk from animals + lemon from plants). Misconceptions: 'penguins live in our locality' (penguins live in cold places like Antarctica, not in India), 'food comes from the shop' (shop is where food is sold, but food comes from plants and animals first), 'all trees give fruits' (neem gives medicine, banyan gives shade, not all trees give fruits we can eat), 'mountains are just big rocks' (mountains are land features with soil, plants, animals, and water streams). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function MyEnvironmentGame), NOT export default. Export interface MyEnvironmentGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
